verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's developer docs say users can connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, or another MCP client to check calendars, find open times, book meetings, and manage links from a chat. That points to a first-party MCP server, but it rests on a single brief mention with no setup or reference documentation. missing for 10: documented MCP server endpoint/install instructions, authentication details for the MCP connection, a list of exposed tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, or another MCP client to check your calendar, find open times, book meetings, and manage your links from a chat.
